nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of MoNi₄
nodes.procedure: 3D porous MoNi₄ network fabricated on nickel foam by a hydrothermal method followed by annealing in the presence of hydrogen.
nodes.source_text: Shen et al. [24] synthesized a 3D porous MoNi₄ network fabricated on nickel foam by a hydrothermal method followed by annealing in the presence of hydrogen.

nodes.name: Core-shell NT formation and nitridation
nodes.procedure: Core–shell MoO₃@Ni(OH)₂ nanotubes (NTs) were first fabricated by utilizing nickel acetate and MoO₃ nanorods as starting materials. Uniform incorporation of Fe was obtained by stirring the core–shell MoO₃@Ni(OH)₂ NTs in an aqueous iron nitrate solution at room temperature to form MoO₃@NiFe(OH)₂ NTs. The hierarchical core–shell MoO₃@NiFe(OH)₂ NTs were further converted into hierarchical NiFeMo tri-metal nitride nanotubes (NiFe-MoN NTs) by annealing for 2 h at 500°C in ammonia.

unit_operations.name: Core-shell NT formation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: basic etching method of synthesizing core–shell MoO₃@Ni(OH)₂ nanotubes (NTs) in water/ethanol solutions; these NTs were first fabricated by utilizing nickel acetate and MoO₃ nanorods as starting materials

unit_operations.name: Fe incorporation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Uniform incorporation of Fe was obtained by stirring the core–shell MoO₃@Ni(OH)₂ NTs in an aqueous iron nitrate solution at room temperature

unit_operations.name: Nitriding
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: The hierarchical core–shell MoO₃@NiFe(OH)₂ NTs were further converted into hierarchical NiFeMo tri-metal nitride nanotubes (represented as NiFe-MoN NTs) by annealing for 2 h at 500°C in ammonia

nodes.source_text: Zhu et al. [16] developed a basic etching method of synthesizing core–shell MoO₃@Ni(OH)₂ nanotubes... annealing for 2 h at 500°C in ammonia.

nodes.name: Thermal ammonolysis of NiFe-LDH
nodes.procedure: Ni₃FeN NPs synthesized by a thermal ammonolysis process using ultrathin NiFe-LDH as a precursor.
nodes.source_text: Jia's group [44] reported the successful synthesis of efficient bifunctional Ni₃FeN NPs for OWS by a thermal ammonolysis process using ultrathin NiFe-LDH as a precursor.

nodes.name: CoN nanowire synthesis on CC
nodes.procedure: Used an easy method to prepare porous cobalt nitride (CoN) nanowires with a length of 7 mm and a diameter of 135 nm on carbon cloth (CC) for the OWS reaction.
nodes.source_text: Xue et al. [45] used an easy method to prepare porous cobalt nitride (CoN) nanowires... on carbon cloth (CC).

nodes.name: Pyrolysis of Mo/Zn BIF
nodes.procedure: Nitrogen and oxygen surface-terminated 2D Mo₂C nanomeshes (NMs) and assembling them into 3D microflowers (MFs) by one-step pyrolysis of Mo@Zn bimetallic imidazolate frameworks.
nodes.source_text: Kou et al. [58] developed an easy method for preparing nitrogen and oxygen surface-terminated 2D Mo₂C nanomeshes (NMs) and assembling them into 3D microflowers (MFs) by one-step pyrolysis of Mo@Zn bimetallic imidazolate frameworks.
